text.en: The children play Statue. They keep turning round and round until the teacher says Statue! Everyone stops. How much has each child turned from the starting place?

A turn is how much we rotate. Turning all the way round and coming back to the start is a full turn.
Ashutosh made a full circle by one full turn. Sahana made a half-moon shape with a half turn. The minute hand of a clock makes a full turn when it comes back to where it began.
Two half turns in the same direction make a full turn. Two quarter turns make a half turn and four quarter turns make a full turn.
Turns happen everywhere: a tap, a door on its hinge, scissors, tongs and a clothes clip. Each has a limit, such as less than a quarter turn or a half turn.
Pragya joined a green straw and a yellow straw with a paper clip. Holding the green steady she turned the yellow one. A quarter turn makes a right angle.
Angles arise in situations that involve a turn. Less than a quarter turn is an acute angle, more than a quarter but less than a half turn is an obtuse angle, and a half turn is a straight angle.
(additional, not in the textbook) A right angle is also the corner of a book or a door, and it measures 90 degrees.

problem.en: Reema takes 2 quarter turns in the same direction. What turn is it?

text.en: One quarter turn is one-fourth of a full turn.

why.en: Think of the clock hand from 12 to 3.

text.en: Two quarter turns together are 2 fourths.
2/4 is the same as a half turn.

why.en: So she has made a half turn.
